summary: Growth topology reference workloads: 8 API requests/s with 500 ms p50 and 1.5 s p99, 1,000 inventory hosts, 20 job starts/s, 10 concurrent jobs at default 5 forks plus 100 with forks=1, 10,000 job events/s peak, 30 days of history under 60 GB, certified sync under 30 min, validated under 5 min, and 6 activations at 1 actionable event/minute with skip audit events.
questions: What workload can the AAP growth topology handle?
How many hosts does the growth topology support?
How many concurrent jobs can a growth topology run?
AAP growth topology API requests per second

answer_card.title: Growth topology reference workloads
answer_card.answer_md:
| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| REST API | 8 RPS (p50 500 ms, p99 1.5 s) |
| Inventory hosts | 1,000 |
| Job start rate | 20 per second |
| Concurrent jobs | 10 at 5 forks + 100 at forks=1 |
| Callback receiver | 10,000 events/s peak |
| Job history | 30 days, under 60 GB |
| Certified / validated sync | under 30 min / under 5 min |
| EDA | 6 activations, 1 actionable event/min, skip audit events |
